 بروض الفرج

يتم تغذية جهاز الوقاية بجهد التشغيل المناسب (جهد خرج الشحن) باللوحة

 الوجه الأول 
 R
 لجهاز 
 الوقاية

يتم زيادة قيمة تيار 
 الحقن بشكل تدريجى حتى نصل الى القيمة المقننة
 I
 pickup
 وتتم عملية الفصل 
 بجهاز الوقاية

 هذه القيمةI
 pickup

 جهاز الوقاية بقيمة التيار المخزونة دفعة واحدة وتسجيل زمن الفصل

يتم حساب معامل 
 الرجوع عن طريق تقليل تيار الحقن تدريجيا لحين خفض تيار الحقن بجهاز الحقن

 لجهاز الوقاية

وحده القصرSC 
element

 ويكون الزمن لحظى ( زمن فصل جهاز الوقاية فى هذه الحالة لحظى (
 0.04sec - 0sec 
 )

 (47, 48)

 Trip لجهاز الوقاية الى نقاط 
 الساعة بجهاز الحقن لتسجيل الزمن

Maintenance Procedure Information System
 | Protection | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: OCR-071-r0a | Equipment:
 Overcurrent and Earth Leakage Protection, SC
 MICOM P122
 ALSTOM
Issued to: 
 Distribution Companies
Status: 
 Approved
Approval date: 
 13 November 2008 | Procedure:
 Annual Testing and Calibration 
 (
 P1- Y1 )
Next review date: November 
 2013
Introduction
The device performs many functions, including overcurrent and earth leakage protection, disturbance recorders, Cold load pick up, and current, voltage and power measurements, etc.
This document was prepared by Upper Egypt Electricity Distribution Company and was reviewed and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the distribution companies on 13 November 2008.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Ensure fencing off and posting of warning signs at the work location.
Occupational safety and health instructions must be followed at the work site.
Ensure the circuit breaker is switched off and withdrawn outside the cell.
Do not open current transformer terminals while in service or under test, and do not short-circuit the secondary winding terminals of the voltage transformers of the protection device.
Ensure the protection device is earthed in the cell.
Issue an approved work order; maintenance personnel must carry the occupational safety and health category card.
Ensure fencing off and posting of warning signs at the work location.
Occupational safety and health instructions must be followed at the work site.
Ensure the circuit breaker is switched off and withdrawn outside the cell.
Do not open current transformer terminals while in service or under test, and do not short-circuit the secondary winding terminals of the voltage transformers of the protection device.
Ensure the protection device is earthed in the cell.
Tools, Instruments and Equipment Used
Secondary injection device suitable for the protection device (digital), supplied with its accessories, with current injection leads and Trip leads for recording the tripping time.
Procedures to be Followed
First: Overcurrent Test with a 5 Ampere Secondary Winding
Test values shall be determined and the devices programmed to operate on them according to the instructions of the Central Protection at Rod El Farag | 1.
The protection device shall be supplied with the appropriate operating voltage (charger output voltage) on the panel at points (33, 34) | 2.
The injection device current leads shall be connected to the terminals of the first phase R of the protection device at points (41, 47) | 3.
The injection current value shall be increased gradually until reaching the rated value I pickup, and tripping shall be effected by the protection device | 4.
Record this value I pickup, and set the injection device to this value | 5.
Connect the Trip leads of the protection device to the timer points (2, 6) on the injection device to record the tripping time | 6.
